capabilities: Answer questions from notes it reads, citing lines as links
Create and edit notes only after approval cards
Rewind a conversation and revert the agent's changes
Run a vault-scoped bash shell and fetch URLs with curl
Connect MCP servers and WebDAV storage
disambiguation: Not a note-organizing or cleanup tool; despite the name, it is a chat agent that answers from and edits notes.
extras: README includes a detailed Privacy section covering what reaches the model provider, vault enumeration, and curl behavior; the manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. API keys are sealed with a sync passphrase (PBKDF2-SHA256, AES-256-GCM) so devices only need the passphrase.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in agent that can browse a vault like a coding agent, cite the exact lines it read, and apply note changes under user control.

relations.evidence: from Ollama for models it serves (also behind Open WebUI)
a model that Open WebUI takes from Ollama's cloud

summary: AI chat agent that searches vault notes with tools, answers with cited line links, and edits files only after approval cards, on desktop and mobile.
